newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic/NYNEX name Killian to new int'l unit.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic/NYNEX name Killian to new int'l unit.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp and NYNEX Corp said Tuesday they named John Killian to the position of group president of International Telecommunications for the new Bell Atlantic.
Most recently, Killian was president and chief executive of NYNEX CableComms Group, a combined telephony-cable television company in the United Kingdom.

Killian will oversee the newly merged company's international wireline investments in the United Kingdom, Thailand, the Philippines and New Zealand as well as Fiberoptic Link Around the Globe (FLAG), the world's longest undersea fiber optic cable.
He will report to the office of the chairman, the companies said.
Bell Atlantic and NYNEX said last year they plan to merge in a deal valued at about $20 billion.
